name: HALF-LIGHT
author: David (davidaparicio2205-dotcom), after Charles Vestal's AMB-1
tagline: Four eras of night music for the FM-1
description: HALF-LIGHT is a generative ambient machine for the M-VAVE FM-1 in four eras, two pieces each: after dark (monochrome, intimate, a phased and chorused pad), the long glow (big pads, soft piano, neon haze), clean signal (a formant choir that turns mechanical, glitching bells) and cut and paste (fragments, two-step pulses, cold electronics). It plays itself from the moment it is switched on, and every era has its own moving screen that follows the sound. Built on Charles Vestal's AMB-1.
credits: A fork of AMB-1 by Charles Vestal. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
